tour.intro: What is new in Nomikos: a quick tour on the Grec 1360 manuscript
tour.pickers: The HTR and SEG pickers now show short model names like greek-v1 and seg-v1
tour.jobs: Start a job and the Background jobs panel tracks it above the page
tour.jobs_cancel: A queued job can be cancelled from the panel
tour.numbering_draw: Draw a segment with the Rect tool (B)
tour.numbering_number: Segments are numbered by position on the page, so the new one slots in
tour.numbering_delete: Delete removes it again and the numbers close up
tour.pane: The transcript sits side by side with the page, one box per line
tour.pane_close: The x closes the transcript pane and the line strip comes back
tour.pane_toggle: The Transcript button in the toolbar brings the pane back
tour.region_draw: The Region tool (G) draws a box around a folio or column
tour.region_label: Give the region a label, here the folio number 4v
tour.editor_export: The Workflow menu has an Export section: PDF, Word and PAGE XML
tour.doc_download: On the document page, Download offers Word, PDF and plain text
tour.feedback: The Feedback icon opens a short form that goes straight to the team
tour.admin: Admins get an Admin page with usage and database load
tour.outro: Back on the projects page. That is the round

explainer.intro: Welcome to Nomikos. This video walks through the platform from sign up to export
explainer.register: Open the Register page and fill in email, username and password
explainer.register_submit: Click Create account. You land on your projects page
explainer.login: Log in with your email and password
explainer.project_new: Click New project and name it
explainer.project_created: The project opens. Documents live inside projects
explainer.doc_new: Click New document and give it the manuscript's name
explainer.doc_created: The document page lists its pages. It is empty for now
explainer.upload: Click Upload pages and pick your page images
explainer.uploaded: Each image becomes a page of the document
explainer.workflow: Open Workflow and pick the segmentation model
explainer.segment: Segment unsegmented pages finds the text lines on every page
explainer.queued: The server segments the pages in the background; about a minute per page
explainer.queued_more: The project page lists the queued jobs. You can keep working meanwhile
explainer.switch: Let us continue on a document that is already segmented and transcribed
explainer.shared_project: This project was shared with us, so it appears on the projects page
explainer.open_doc: Open the document and click a page to open the editor
explainer.editor: The editor: the page on the left, its transcript side by side on the right
explainer.fit: Use the zoom buttons below the page, or scroll, to zoom in and out
explainer.select_line: Click a line on the page and its text box lights up on the right
explainer.edit_line: Correct the text in the box. Changes save as you type
explainer.region_tool: Press G or click Region to draw a box around a folio
explainer.region_label: Label the region with its folio number, here 4v
explainer.settings: The gear opens editor settings, including the side by side text panel
explainer.settings_off: Untick it to get the strip under the page instead
explainer.settings_on: Tick it again for the side by side view
explainer.export_page: Workflow, then Export: download this page as Word (.docx)
explainer.export_doc: On the document page, Download exports the whole document
explainer.export_doc_more: Choose Word, a transcription PDF, or plain text
explainer.share_project: To share a project, open it and click Share
explainer.share_add: Type a colleague's email. They can then open and edit every document
explainer.share_done: Your colleague now appears under Sharing and sees the project
explainer.publish: To show a document to anyone, open Publish on the document page
explainer.publish_confirm: Publishing makes a secret, read only link to the document
explainer.publish_link: The link appears under the title. Anyone who has it can read the pages
explainer.public_view: Opened in a fresh browser without logging in: a read only page
explainer.public_view_more: Visitors can read and download but cannot edit anything
explainer.outro: Back on your projects page. That is Nomikos. Happy transcribing
